sections.title: Asking where
sections.content: *Hol* means “where”. It asks about a place, so the answer names a place with *-ban* or *-ben*: *Hol van a táska?* – *A táska a szobában van.* The question word and the place in the answer both stand right before the verb. The same works for you and me: *Hol vagy?* – *A konyhában vagyok.*

sections.title: Only for being somewhere
sections.content: *Hol* asks where something is, not where it is going. Movement needs a different question word, which comes later.

items.english: The bag is in the room.

sections.content: In English the place usually comes last: “The bag is in the room.” In Hungarian the place comes right before the verb: *A táska a szobában van.* Build the answer around that spot, the same spot where *Hol* stood in the question.
